news.title: Father Calls Daughter, the Co-Pilot Killed in Florida Crash, ‘a Hero’
news.summary: Allan Filgueiras said during a news conference that his daughter, Nathalia, 20, fought to the final seconds as a private jet carrying nine people crashed near Palm Beach, Fla.
